sentences.en: I had to grab her to keep her from falling.
sentences.zh: 我得抓紧她，不然她会摔倒。

sentences.en: Could you go to the store and grab some eggs?
sentences.zh: 你能去商店买些鸡蛋吗？

sentences.en: Sophie, who was hungry, ate everything that she could grab.
sentences.zh: 索菲饿了，什么都往嘴里抓。
